projects.note: Panda 230 kV ring bus expansion: 2 new breakers, one breaker relocated, Gila Bend/Solana/Freedom line positions relocated, CEC and land. TPIF $5.9M includes relocating line entrances. Gillespie–Patterson 69 kV rebuild required, at APS's cost.
One 69 kV breaker position. Not attributed to any thermal, voltage, stability or short-circuit concern.

notes: No system network upgrades are allocated to the Gila Bend serial projects. Q288's Facilities Study requires a Gillespie–Patterson 69 kV rebuild but assigns it to APS, with no cost to the customer. Q346's Facilities Study finds no system reinforcements.
Both projects carry only POI station network upgrades. Palo Verde/Hassayampa fault-duty mitigation is 'TBD by SRP'.
Q357 (150 MW storage at Freedom 69 kV) is COD – pending refund and is treated as in service, not part of this block.
view_note: Only two serial projects remain in the Gila Bend area: Q288 (200 MW at Panda 230 kV, in construction) and Q346 (45 MW at Komatke 69 kV, suspended). Neither carries shared system upgrades. Q288's $9.2M Panda ring-bus expansion is the largest station upgrade, and the Gillespie–Patterson 69 kV rebuild it triggered is at APS's cost.
full_note: The serial block adds just 245 MW and no shared upgrades. Shared Gila Bend upgrades first appear in the Transition and later cluster studies shown below.
